mapper.sql: id, project_id, page_order, page_type, page_title, page_content, components, page_version, client_version, autosave, dirty, last_saved_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ws_page WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY page_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ws_page(project_id, page_order, page_type, page_title, page_content, components, page_version, client_version, autosave, dirty, last_saved_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{project_id}, #{page_order}, #{page_type}, #{page_title}, #{page_content}, #{components}, COALESCE(#{page_version}, 1), #{client_version}, COALESCE(#{autosave}, 0), COALESCE(#{dirty}, 0), NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ws_page WHERE id = #{id} AND project_id = #{projectId}
